strategy_version: BTC+ETH Macro Hedge V3.10 - V3.1 + Isolated Stage3 Bear Re-entry Confirmation

models.H0: Initial Only - no DCA, no tactical trading

isolated_stage3_confirmation.eligibility_activation: an unchanged V3.1 NEW_BULL_CONFIRMED has occurred earlier in the same replay
isolated_stage3_confirmation.candidate_trigger: eligible and unchanged V3.1 would enter Stage3 from EARLY_BEAR
isolated_stage3_confirmation.candidate_exposure: hold the last legally executed V3.1 target; create no replacement buy, sell, or target
isolated_stage3_confirmation.candidate_break: reject on first completed close that does not meet both confirmation conditions
isolated_stage3_confirmation.candidate_restart: a later unchanged V3.1 Stage3 signal may create a new candidate
isolated_stage3_confirmation.sma200_hard_failure_effect: cancel candidate and hand the same completed daily row back to unchanged V3.1 FSM; no new target or trade is created by the hard-failure rule
isolated_stage3_confirmation.stage4_priority: same-date original V3.1 Stage4 is authoritative, cancels candidate, and executes without delay
isolated_stage3_confirmation.crash_l1_l2_priority: unchanged V3.1 Crash L1/L2 execute without delay and cancel candidate
isolated_stage3_confirmation.stage3_module_reuse: direct import of V3.9 frozen _new_candidate and _resolve_candidate helpers
isolated_stage3_confirmation.bearish_rebreak: unchanged V3.1 outside the original Stage3 transition

audit_conventions.cycle_eligibility_interpretation: historical eligibility latch is required because V3.1 closes the NEW_BULL cycle at redeploy completion; literal current-cycle new_bull_date would make the requested rule unreachable
audit_conventions.completed_daily_execution: a completed UTC daily close becomes available and is acted on at the next tradable 4h open
audit_conventions.direct_difference: only an original V3.1 Stage3 execution held for confirmation
audit_conventions.indirect_difference: later fill or no-fill caused by exposure/cash path inherited from a direct Stage3 delay; must name causal_parent_stage3_candidate_id
audit_conventions.unexpected_difference: any difference not causally traceable to a Stage3 candidate
audit_conventions.forward_comparison: ex-post audit only; never present in the execution frame
audit_conventions.candidate_forward_value_sampling: first available daily portfolio observation on or after candidate_date plus 30 or 60 calendar days
audit_conventions.candidate_local_drawdown: cash-flow-adjusted unit_nav drawdown reset at candidate date and measured through candidate_date plus 60 calendar days
audit_conventions.incremental_exposure_days: daily sum of Q crypto exposure minus B crypto exposure from original Stage3 candidate date through Q confirmation or rejection date, inclusive
audit_conventions.period_drawdown_basis: cash-flow-adjusted unit_nav, reset to first observation in each window

prohibited: duplicate suppression, episode lock, sticky 35 percent, or one-rung
